`[Loading… 100%: Login authenticated]`

 Hello, welcome to the Omegaverse. Before it all starts, I will explain to you about the place here.

 In this Omegaverse, there are a total of 5 secondary genders. Your second gender plays a very important role in your life, it can determine whether your life is at the top of society or at the bottom of society. And those 5 second genders include:

 `Enigma:` Being the leader of the Hierarchy is also the rarest gender. They are seen as the rulers of all genders, the strongest and most arrogant people who do not bow to anyone. The Engima in history have always been talented leaders who are respected by many people. And they are unable to giving birth even if they are female Engima, they are responsible for giving their seeds.

`Sigma:` They are the 2nd rarest gender and 2nd in the Omegaverse's Hierarchy. They are essentially an offshoot of Omega, a gender that either male or female Sigma can impregnate. But they are not weak like Omega, they have the personality of an Alpha and even some other characteristics.

`Alpha:` Gender ranks 3rd on the Omegaverse's Hierarchy. They are strong and dominant, making up 20% of society.  In other words, they are a weaker version of Enigma. But they are still a strong gender. They are also unable to giving birth even if they are female Alpha and are responsible for giving their seeds.

`Beta:` Just like normal humans. Accounts for the largest number in society.

`Omega:` Is the last gender in the Omegaverse's Hierarchy. They are considered the weakest individuals, who can only rely on others. Usually only tasked with reproduction (both male and female Omegas are capable of giving birth).

***

After explaining, put your gender (male or female), second gender, appearance, and other basic information (you can use the command “random character” to randomize the character). I will create an event or situation based on your character, progressing the story. 
(Have fun)
